Ellen: FYI - customer 'Terran Labs' hit three declines this morning. Gateway message = 'foreign_bin_not_allowed'. Cards tried: last4 5454 (MC) and 3782 (Amex). ACH attempt timed out.
Marco: Got it. Charge IDs ch_06ABCD..., invoice INV-3347. Can you DM the customer about wire?
Ellen: DM'd. They need payroll covered today so want fastest path.
Kasia: Finance ok to accept wire or virtual card. We'll waive one late fee if remittance arrives by EOD. Please get remittance screenshot and payer name.
Devi: Pausing autopay retries for this merchant and adding rule to stop retries on error class 'foreign_bin_not_allowed'. Patch rolling to prod now.
PaymentsBot: autopay_flag updated for terran-labs - retries suspended.
Marco: Also opened gateway ticket GATE-8892 to ask why BIN flagged as foreign; adding merchant MCC and token payload for review.
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#12456 created for Terran Labs payment failure.
Ellen: Sent wire template and virtual card instructions. Told them: reply with remittance to mark invoice settled.
Marco: Quick commands I used: `curl "https://payments.redwood/internal/charges?invoice=INV-3347" | jq .`
Kasia: Finance ops: once remittance clears set invoice.status='settled-wire' and cancel any scheduled retry job. Attach proof to Z#12456.
Devi: Will follow up with gateway response and add a test case to the payment-harness for foreign BIN blocks.
Ellen: Closing loop for now - Marco to post gateway follow-up, Devi to keep autopay suspended, Kasia to watch for remittance. Thanks :thumbsup:
